## Current behavior

`E2E / Full Regression` on `main` (run [40797057651](https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/actions/runs/40797057651), SHA `e3c654971`) fails at the `e2e-playwright` Gate before any test runs:

```
Playwright list contained no spec paths (bytes=33472 lines=271 has_listing=true has_no_tests=false
sample="Listing tests:\n  attach-critical-path.spec.ts:148:7 › …")
```

`e2e/runner/verify-playwright-list.cjs` only accepts a path-prefixed reference (`tests/browser/foo.spec.ts:12`). Playwright 1.52, with this repository's `testDir: './tests/browser'`, prints the file relative to `testDir` (`  foo.spec.ts:12:3 › …`), so every real Full run parses zero spec paths. The defect was masked because the `full` job was skipped on recently sampled main runs.

## Expected behavior

The verifier accepts Playwright's current testDir-relative listing, keeps accepting path-prefixed and project-prefixed shapes, and still fails closed on an empty listing or catalog drift.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 `verify-playwright-list.cjs` parses basename, path-prefixed and project-prefixed Playwright listings into canonical catalog paths; a fixture suite proves all three shapes and the empty-list failure, and a synthetic list of all 34 registered specs reaches discovery parity.
